description:
About our brand and products

Jellzy is a konjac jelly wash in a squishy heart. Squeeze it and it blooms into a soft, cushiony lather that washes face, hands and body, then rinses clean — no tight, stripped feeling afterward. Every box ships with a konjac sponge.

  • 11 clean ingredients. No sulfates, parabens, silicones or fillers. Cruelty-free.
  • Four shades: Rose Red, Taro Purple, Matcha Green, Starry Blue
  • Single heart $19.99 · Pair $29.99 · Full Heart Set $44.99 (all four shades, konjac sponge, and the Heart Holder — only in this set)
  • Free US shipping at $44.99, 90-day money-back guarantee with nothing to ship back
  • A kids line is also available

We're a Shopify DTC brand selling worldwide in USD.

What makes us different

Most cleansers are hard to make content about. Jellzy isn't — that's the whole pitch for a creator.

  • It's inherently filmable. The squish, the bloom into lather, the four colors. The product does the hook for you in the first two seconds.
  • Nobody else owns this format. Bar soap dries you out, pump bottles all look identical. A heart-shaped jelly wash has no direct shelf competitor, so there's no "which brand is this" confusion in comments.
  • It sells as a set, not a single. The Full Heart Set at $44.99 is our best seller, so commissions land on a real order value instead of a $6 impulse buy.
  • Low refund anxiety. 90 days, full refund, nothing to ship back. Easy to say out loud in a video, and it converts.
  • It crosses niches. Skincare, ASMR and satisfying content, aesthetic bathroom and desk setups, parents (kids line), gifting and stocking stuffers.

How affiliates can earn

  • [X]% commission on every sale you drive
  • [X]-day cookie window — you get credit even if they buy later
  • Paid via [PayPal / store credit], [monthly / on the 1st and 15th], with a $[X] minimum payout
  • Average order value sits around $40, so a Full Heart Set at $44.99 pays roughly $[X] per order
  • [Optional: bonus tier — e.g. extra 5% once you pass 20 orders in a month]
  • [Optional: free product for approved creators with an engaged audience]
  • Personal discount code for your audience: [X]% off

Sign up, get your link and code, start sharing. No sales minimum to join.

How to promote us

Whatever you make, lead with the squish. That's the hook.

  • TikTok / Reels: first-time-squishing reaction, ASMR lather sounds, "washing got boring, then this," unboxing the Full Heart Set with all four shades, morning or nighttime routine, before-and-after skin feel
  • Sink and shelf content: color-matched bathroom flatlays, the Heart Holder on a counter, "my sink glow-up"
  • The four-step routine: wet the sponge, squeeze the jelly, buff, rinse — an easy, evergreen explainer
  • Gifting angles: Valentine's, Mother's Day, birthdays, stocking stuffers, teen and tween gifts
  • Kids: bath-time content, "the only thing that gets them to wash their hands"
  • Blog, email and Pinterest: clean-ingredient roundups, konjac sponge explainers, gift guides
  • Comparison content: jelly wash vs bar soap vs pump bottle

Tag @jellzyshop on Instagram and @jellzy_shop on TikTok and we'll reshare. Product photos, videos and brand assets are available in the affiliate portal.

Other information

  • Disclose the partnership clearly — #ad or #affiliate — per FTC guidelines.
  • Jellzy is a cosmetic cleanser, not a treatment. Please don't claim it cures or treats acne, eczema, rosacea or any medical condition, and don't make anti-aging claims.
  • No bidding on branded keywords ("Jellzy," "Jellzy jelly wash," misspellings) in paid search.
  • No posting our codes to coupon or deal aggregator sites.
  • No spam, no misleading claims, no adult or hateful content alongside our brand.
  • Commissions on refunded or cancelled orders are reversed. Self-referred purchases don't earn commission.

Welcome to Jellzy! Thanks for joining our Affiliate program.

These following terms and conditions apply to individuals who are accessing or using the Program both as a merchant (“we” or “merchant”) and an affiliate (“you” or “affiliate”) who refers customers to use product or service from the merchant.

By participating in the Program, Affiliate agrees to use the Program in the manner specified in, and are bound by, these Terms and Conditions. If you do not agree to these Terms and Conditions in their entirety you are not authorized to register as an Affiliate or participate in the Program in any manner.


1. Approve or Reject of the Registration

We reserve the right to approve or reject ANY Affiliate Program Registration in our sole and absolute discretion. You will have no legal recourse against us for the rejection of your Affiliate Program Registration.


2. Affiliate Links and Coupon

Affiliate link is automatically generated, but you can also generate an affiliate link for a specific product or collection. If a person clicks on someone else’s referral link and then later they click on yours, yours is the one that counts.

Affiliate might or might not be assigned to one coupon code with details and usage clarified on Dashboard. If customer both click on the affiliate link and use coupon code, you will not receive a double commission. If you’re not assigned a branded coupon, then you’re not allowed to promote the coupon.

Affiliate may also advertise merchant website on online channels such as Facebook, Instagram,... or offline classified channel ads, magazines, and newspapers.


3. Commissions and payment

Refer any customer to make a purchase on our website, you will get a commission amount which is calculated based on Commission structure. Commission amount is dependent on order value and not including extra fee (tax, shipping cost,...).

For an Affiliate to receive a commission, you need to specify the payment details on Settings. Payment schedule will be notified on Affiliate Guide page.

Payments will only be sent for transactions that have been successfully completed. Use of the Affiliate Program is subject to a fair use policy which gives merchant the right to review each and every referral order. Status of commission if displayed in Commission tab, any paid commission will be listed on Payment tab. Transactions that result in charge backs or refunds will not be paid out.


4. Marketing tool

We may share promotion media such as banner, logo or specific collection promotion to you through Marketing tool tab. You can download the media or get the HTML embed code in order to share on affiliate channels.


5. Network

If Network tab is activated, affiliate can invite others to become their downline affiliate. If any downline affiliate brings order to merchant shop, upline affiliate will also get network commission which depends on merchant settings.

To invite other affiliates into the system, share network link and any other affiliate who click on that link and sign up will become a downline affiliate.


6. Cookie

We use a cookie to track people who have clicked on your link, so they need to be using cookies for us to track them.

If a person doesn't allow cookies or clears their cookies then we can't track them so can't pay earnings on that person's activity.

Cookies day is said on the Affiliate registration form. The tracking day will start from the time a customer clicks on the affiliate’s link or use the coupon. Within the cookie time, every order made by this customer at merchant website will automatically result in commissions to the affiliate (There’s no need for the customer to click on the affiliate link then).


7. Removal from Referral Program

If an affiliate wishes to be removed from the affiliate program, they can do so by contacting: jellzys@gmail.com


Go forward and refer!

We're very glad you've made it to the end of this important document.

We wish you all the very best. You can always re-visit these Affiliate Program terms and conditions in the future and if you have any questions you can send email to jellzys@gmail.com for support.
